text: March animals feed you as well as the Overworld's do. Their meat is **Raw Game**, and a Dawn Stag's hide gives **March Leather**.
Roast Game is as filling as a steak, which makes long trips through the March much easier.
- **Dawn Stag**: 1 to 3 Raw Game and 0 to 2 March Leather.
Looting adds up to one more of each. An animal that dies burning drops its meat already roasted.
pages.title: Where it comes from

text: Raw Game restores **3** hunger and not much saturation. Roast Game restores **8** with high saturation.
Cook it in a furnace, a smoker (twice as fast) or on a campfire (slowest, but no fuel).
Both count as meat: wolves will eat it, and other mods treat it as raw or cooked meat.
pages.title: Cooking and eating

text: One March Leather crafts into one ordinary leather, so anything that asks for leather, like a Silent Drum, is only a crafting step away.
It also counts as leather for other mods that accept any leather.
pages.title: March Leather

pages.text: One March Leather makes one leather.
